segment.source: Renders the opening claim with the entry price and its billing period set as a figure beside the action, plus a line of small print for the conditions. Use it for: single-plan products, courses and tickets, service packages, campaign pages that must show the number before the fold, price-led advertising landings. Prefer 'Event Hero' when the price is one fact among a date and a venue, and 'Product Hero' when pricing belongs further down the page.
